summary: Publishing records, link cards and Bluesky drafts.

src/posting/lib/linkCard.js.note: normalizeAssociatedRefs is Embeds.normalizeAssociatedRefs (posting-text ported it for embeds.js), which LinkCard's forwards to. A response's blob type follows Fetch's MIME extraction for the shapes a card image server sends (lists, case, parameters); quoted parameters with escapes are approximated. The web's File objects are ComposerFiles (Lib/ComposerFiles.swift).
